name: scan-free-start-proved-by-log-text
body: The clean-start arm proves "starts without a scan" from the captured coordinator stderr — it asserts `DB_OPEN_MARKER` is present and neither the rebuild line nor any `[load]` line is — rather than comparing `db.lbug` bytes or mtime, because lbug rewrites `db.lbug` merely on open. Upgrade to a byte- or content-identity-based proof if a scan-free start ever needs evidence independent of log text.
